Material category is the first discriminator; IFC class alone never selects a work item
Aerated-concrete blocks are masonry (MAS-AAC), never cast concrete
Concrete block / CMU is masonry
Precast concrete routes to precast installation, not cast-in-place items
Explicit cast-in-place concrete routes to RC rebar/formwork/concrete items
Concrete with unstated method requires user confirmation before routing
Steel elements are excluded from RC work packages
Timber elements are excluded from RC work packages
Masonry (brick, sand-lime) routes to masonry items by material
Elements without material are blocked from work-package generation
Foundation detection is NOT class-based: IfcBeam/IfcSlab/IfcWall with foundation name or foundation storey are foundation CANDIDATES
IfcFooting is a foundation but its type (pad/strip/pile cap) needs PredefinedType or geometry confirmation
Slab on grade vs suspended slab decides whether slab formwork applies
Spatial adjacency (IfcRelConnects*, Mendeley spatial relations) never creates a classification or precedence
Exporter-specific: SCH Synchro elements are classified through their design-model element (name suffix "_(#STEP id)")
Excavation of the same zone before blinding/foundation work
Blinding before foundation reinforcement/formwork where blinding is specified
Method A (formwork first): shutter, then place cage inside
Method B (reinforcement first): prefabricated cages, then formwork
Reinforcement and formwork complete (and inspected) before foundation concrete
Column cage before column formwork (typical)
Reinforcement and formwork before placement where the method requires both
Placement before curing/strength development
Formwork removal only after the approved striking criterion (strength or time) is met
Supporting columns/walls cast and adequate before loading formwork of supported members
Vertical progression storey by storey for supported structure
Zone progression by crew availability, not by precedence
Backfill after foundation completion and inspection
Masonry after its supporting slab/foundation
Precast floor units before topping concrete
Spatial adjacency, contact or containment alone NEVER creates a dependency
Never add 05HED00001 to 03ERM*/03ERT* items
Add FRM-STRIP exactly once per 05HEM* area
Curing is a schedule constraint only; no cost/labour line
Mutually exclusive per slab
Allocate each kg of reinforcement to exactly one element
Approved measurement rule (deduct at T-beams or not); check IFC geometry overlap
Approved rule (clear height vs through)
Use concrete layer only (e.g. SCH prefab floor fraction 0.6006)
Use one model per project version; link via STEP-id suffix
Never aggregate snapshots
Foundation classification (CR11) excludes element from BEAM-* items
Convert only with approved factors
No separate cleaning item
Use NetSideArea or deduct openings
Relative tolerance for independent quantity checks
